title: SG Car Workshop workshop record (data/workshops/<slug>.json)
note: The only Google value stored is place_id (+ pass/fail screen result). Everything else comes from the workshop's own website, Facebook or WhatsApp Business page, OneMap (coordinates) or our own fields. Page text, CTAs, WhatsApp prefill, Maps URLs and JSON-LD are built by templates from these fields; no display strings are stored.

phones.evidence: quote or description of what the own source says
phones.source_url: own site / Facebook / WhatsApp Business URL

live_rules: at least one phones[] with kind mobile, e164 matching ^\+65[89]\d{7}$, whatsapp true, evidence, source_url, checked_at
